item.subject: maths
item.stem:
The diagram shows a closed shape drawn on Sana's slate, with vertices labelled A, B, C and D.

Which claim about the figure is correct?

options.A: The figure is a quadrilateral: it has four straight sides.
options.B: The figure is a triangle: it has three straight sides.
options.C: The figure is a circle: its side is a single curve.
options.D: The figure is a five-sided polygon: it has five straight sides.
